description: This file defines the EntityLinkSuggestions class, a Drupal plugin for CKEditor 5 that provides entity link suggestions with configurable entity types and bundles. It includes methods for generating dynamic plugin configuration, building a configuration form, and handling plugin initialization.

classes.name: EntityLinkSuggestions
classes.description: A Drupal plugin class for CKEditor 5 that provides entity link suggestions with configurable entity types and bundles.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor for the EntityLinkSuggestions class, initializing configuration, plugin ID, plugin definition, and dependencies for entity type management.

methods.name: getDynamicPluginConfig
methods.description: Generates dynamic plugin configuration, including a URL for entity link suggestions with CSRF token placeholder.

methods.name: defaultConfiguration
methods.description: Returns the default configuration array for the plugin.

methods.name: buildConfigurationForm
methods.description: Builds a configuration form allowing selection of supported entity types and bundles.

methods.name: submitConfigurationForm
methods.description: Handles form submission for configuration (empty implementation).
